facts.rawText:
Retinol 0.3% Face Serum

Powerful Anti-aging Serum for Fine Lines & Wrinkles

## What Makes It Potent?
- Contains 0.3% pure Retinol in water-free formulation. Retinol is proven to fade fine lines & wrinkles, even skin tone and smoothen skin
- Packed with potent antioxidants. Coenzyme Q10 is an outstanding radical scavenger and visibly reduces wrinkle depth. It is coupled with Tocopherol (Vitamin E), another antioxidant, that nourishes & repairs skin
- Boosted with 1% pure Bakuchiol Oil which in some studies has shown to have similar benefits as Retinol without any irritation. This combination makes it a powerful anti-aging serum
- Retinol is an unstable molecule and it oxidizes in presence of water or light. This product is water-free and uses Squalane as based ingredient. Also this serum comes in a UV Protective bottle, which makes this a highly stable retinol All ingredients are sourced from top quality suppliers. Retinol from BASF, Germany and Coenzyme Q10 from Selco, Germany

## Ideal For
Skin type: Dry/Normal, Sensitive, Oily, Combination, Acne-ProneSuitable for: 18+ years of ageConcerns: Fine Lines, Wrinkles & Loss of Elasticity

## How to Use
Apply on cleansed face after your water based serums, and before moisturizer. Use of sunscreen is highly recommended while using this product.When to use: When to use: PM. Start with every alternate day and after 2 weeks of usage, use it everyday.

## Retinol
Retinol is the most efficacious form of vitamin A. It is the most effective substance for the care of aging and UV-damaged skin because it increases enzyme activity, and normalizes keratinisation, which improves and normalizes the cell renewal process

## Coenzyme Q10
A potent antioxidant, Coenzyme Q10, is a radical scavenger and it protects skin cells against active oxygen structures, resulting in reduction of wrinkle depth

## Bakuchiol Oil
A powerful anti-aging ingredient. Some studies have shown that Bakuchiol Oil has similarities to Retinol in how it affect cell pathways. The duo of Retinol & Bakuchiol Oil, makes this a very powerful anti-aging serum

## All Ingredients
Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Isododecane, Squalane, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Triheptanoin, Tocopheryl Acetate, Bakuchiol, Retinol, Polysorbate 20, Ubiquinone (Coenzyme Q10), BHT

## Can this product cause purging or breakout?
Depending on your skin, it can take time adjusting to Retinol. In the first 2-3 weeks of use, your cell turnover increases, causing your pores to purge. These effects are completely natural and will dissipate in 3-4 weeks. If you are new to Retinol based products, start slow by using the product 2-3 times a week and then slowly increase the usage to daily.

## What is the recommended age, and who can use this product?
Except for pregnant or breastfeeding women and those under 18 years of age, anyone can begin using retinol in their mid-’20s. People with hypersensitive skin should perform a patch test first, and only if it’s tolerable, they should use it on the face. If it’s not acceptable, discontinue usage.

## Can Retinol be used for treating acne as well?
As Retinol improves cell turnover rate, it is very effective against acne. In fact, Retinol is a clinically proven anti-acne active and has shown great efficacy against acne. You can use this serum along with our Salicylic Acid Serum for potent acne treatment.
